# Vendored libraries

Browser builds copied unchanged from the npm packages, with their own licences. Pages load them by relative path and never fetch scripts from a CDN at runtime. These files are MIT-licensed and are not covered by this repo's CC BY-NC licence.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cytoscape.min.js` | [cytoscape](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cytoscape) | 3.30.4 | MIT, `LICENSE-cytoscape.txt` |
| `dagre.min.js` | [dagre](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dagre) (bundles graphlib and lodash, both MIT) | 0.8.5 | MIT, `LICENSE-dagre.txt` |
| `cytoscape-dagre.js` | [cytoscape-dagre](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cytoscape-dagre) | 2.5.0 | MIT, `LICENSE-cytoscape-dagre.txt` |
